title: A question to the owner stands on its own

checks.name: there is a question to judge

reasons: The question (in Portuguese: 'First I check the ledger: does an open task already cover this?') never says what the task is, so a reader who has forgotten it learns nothing.
It doesn't explain what came up or why it needs the owner's input.
It offers no options, so nothing describes what would happen under each choice.
It gives no recommendation and no default action if nobody answers.
It uses unexplained internal jargon: 'ledger' and 'this' are never defined. It does stay under 120 words.
